criterion: MBON11 response to odour A must fall relative to odour B from before to after conditioning: the paired difference of deltas (deltaA - deltaB) must be negative with a 95% CI excluding 0 across >= 20 seeds
gain_note: DEVIATION: every synaptic weight scaled to 0.6 of its published value, because at the published value there is no sparse odour code to store a memory in (stage 3b) and two odours leave indistinguishable ensembles (stage 3e).
reset_note: Membrane potentials and synaptic conductances are reset to rest before every odour presentation; learned weights are not. The model never returns to baseline on its own (stage 3b), so without this the second odour would be delivered into the first odour's ongoing activity and every later measurement would be contaminated.

protocol.sigma_source: conditioning_sigma_mV in configs/stage4_encode.yaml (0.0 mV); the offline background (1.6 mV, from stage 2 operating point: NO critical regime found in the sweep (no sigma satisfied all criteria; the network is bistable - silent below the transition and continuously active above it). The operating point for the downstream stages is therefore NOT a critical point: it is the non-saturated sigma whose Kenyon-cell population rate is closest to the measured KC spontaneous rate of 0.1 Hz (Turner, Bazhenov & Laurent 2008 J Neurophysiol 99:734), i.e. sigma = 1.6 mV (KC rate 1.9667 Hz, whole-brain rate 0.7866 Hz/neuron, m = 0.9999994021964815).) is applied in stage 5
protocol.eta_source: stage 3 calibration against Hige et al. 2015
